headlines.text: Looking back to 2024, when Swerve Strickland vs. Roderick Strong fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.54 ? a good, competitive contest. It was the 50th time the AEW World Heavyweight Title had been on the line, a genuinely rare milestone for that title. Strickland retained his AEW World Title over Strong, who fought through a bad knee before falling to a second House Call, confirming Strickland's spot in the Forbidden Door main event.

Back on this day in 2024, Rugido arrived in AEW against Bryan Danielson vs. Claudio Castagnoli vs. Jon Moxley vs. Wheeler Yuta vs. Esfinge vs. Magnus vs. Volador Jr., appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.51.
Turning the clock back to 2024: Rey Fenix vs. Jay Lethal vs. Kyle O'Reilly vs. Orange Cassidy met in a Number One Contender, kicking off the show on Dynamite, rated 6.77.

Looking back to 2024, when Saraya vs. Mariah May locked horns for the first time on Dynamite, rated 5.17.
